description: Bounded SHD implementation and throughput pilot: four emission/refractory arms, one paired seed, 1024 training and 256 validation examples, two epochs of the original 20-epoch schedule. Never evaluate test data.
decision_rule: Check finite gradients and decreasing training loss. Diagnose any unstable arm before full comparisons. Use median batch times to estimate complete study cost; pilot accuracy is not a benchmark result.
